The safety features NHTSA lists with a rating. A feature is `standard`, `optional`, `both` (standard on some versions, optional on others) or `no`. An evaluation is `meets`, `does_not_meet`, `standard_only`, `upgrade_only` or `pending`. `null` where NHTSA's file does not say. For the four driver-assistance features (forward collision warning, lane departure warning, crash imminent braking, dynamic brake support) NHTSA's file means two things by its years. Through model year 2022, `standard`, `optional` and `both` say the feature is fitted and met NHTSA's performance criteria, `no` says it is not fitted or did not meet them, and there is no evaluation. From model year 2023 the value says only whether the feature is fitted, and the evaluation says what NHTSA's test found.
